notes.minimum_p_up: Minimum forecast probability of upward move to consider a long candidate.
notes.minimum_cost_adjusted_edge: Median forecast return must exceed fees+slippage by at least this fraction.
notes.minimum_asymmetry: Required ratio of upside (q90) to downside (q10) for longs (inverse for shorts).
notes.maximum_volatility_ratio: Reject if forecast volatility is more than this multiple of recent realized volatility.
notes.late_entry_atr_multiple: If current price is more than this many ATRs from the ideal entry zone, mark blocked_by_late_entry.
